subject: Staging to Production Tabletop & Cutover Runbook — scheduling

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staging → Prod: final tabletop / cutover runbook sync

Sarah —

Thanks again for walking through the high level timeline last week. As discussed, we'd like to run one final tabletop with your cross-functional team to validate: cutover steps, rollback/triggers, communications, and clear owners. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 23 Nov, 10:00–11:30
- Tue 23 Nov, 14:00–15:30
- Wed 24 Nov, 09:00–10:30

Proposed agenda (45–75 min):
1) Quick roll call & objectives (5)
2) Walk the cutover runbook (20)
3) Simulated failure scenarios + rollback decisions (20)
4) Final owners and escalation paths (10)
5) Action items and next steps (5)

Attached: draft runbook (runbook_v3.pdf), fallback checklist, and a concise tabletop agenda. Can you confirm who will represent: Production Engineering, Procurement, and Security on the call? Also please confirm which slot works best — Marcus (AE) will lead the call, Diego (SE) will run the runbook walkthrough, Stephanie will own the rollback checklist additions.

If any of those times don't work, let us know and we can shift. Also note: we plan to validate the post-cutover smoke tests within 30 minutes of cutover window.

Thanks —
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook_v3.pdf (13 KB), fallback_checklist.xlsx (7 KB), tabletop-agenda.docx (9 KB)

Thanks for the clear plan. Kevin (procurement) and I reviewed proposed slots; procurement has a vendor review that overlaps the morning slot on Tue 23. Security has availability for the afternoon slot (14:00) but would prefer a slightly shorter call.

Attendees we will confirm:
- Sarah Jenkins — Release Manager
- Kevin Barnes — Procurement (will join for signoff items)
- IT Security — default mailbox (they indicated either Alice Park or on-call)
- Production Eng — I'll confirm primary; likely Aaron Lim

Can we do Tue 23 Nov, 14:00–15:15 PST? If so, please send an invite with video + a dial-in. We also need a short appendix that lists the specific artifacts procurement needs to sign off (SLA appendix, data retention summary). I can add those to the agenda before the call.

Thanks,
Sarah

- We'll compress the runbook walkthrough to 20 minutes and prioritize the procurement appendix during the first 15 minutes.
- Diego will run two simulated failure scenarios focused on DB connection failure and partial KV cache invalidation.
- Stephanie will cover rollback criteria and the decision tree (we'll keep that to 10 minutes).

Action items before the call:
- Marcus: send calendar invite + Zoom link (will include phone dial-in) — by EOD today.
- Sarah: confirm Production Eng primary (Aaron or alternate).
- Kevin: attach any procurement-specific signoff doc(s) to the invite.
- Stephanie & Diego: finalize rollback checklist and smoke-test scripts (linked in runbook).

Forwarding updated runbook with a short procurement appendix (see runbook_v3.pdf — now includes a one-page procurement appendix).
